item.title: David Wasserman: Why voters turned on Trump
item.description: What do the 2026 midterm results reveal about the state of American politics? In this episode of “Make It Make Sense,” Carine Hajjar talks with David Wasserman, an election analyst for the Cook Political Report, about Democrats’ historic gains, Republican losses in the South, why several GOP gerrymanders backfired, and major shifts among Hispanic, young and working-class voters. They also discuss what both parties should learn from the results and how the midterms could reshape the 2028 presidential race.

item.title: The immigration deal Trump should make
item.description:
In a recent interview, President Donald Trump said he’s ready to make a deal on immigration. But what would one that is popular across the political spectrum actually look like?
Host Megan McArdle talks with Alexander Kustov, a political scientist and professor at the University of Notre Dame, about what voters really want from immigration policy and how policymakers could build a system that welcomes immigrants while serving national interests.
